title: Outside of mallworld
content: I used ai to generate this image of the outside area of my mallworld dreams. This is as close as I could get to what it looks like. The main area of the mall/transit area with elevators and balconys of every floor is right in the center of the skyscraper. The hotel is located on the lower levels of the skyscraper for me most of the time. The water park that goes up the side of the outside of the skyscraper has a sort of climbing wall and different platforms to enter the water slides. The roads to mallworld are like a single passenger monorail that comes from other dream locations i have like a school, town, forest. I have also traveled to the mallworld area via helicopter multiple times also.
